The host test expects the aggregate over a window function to be *wrapped* (pushed into a subquery), not rejected. Let me look at the test name: `test_referenced_window_requires_wrapping`. So the correct fix is to force the subquery path when an aggregate references a window function, so the window is computed in the inner query and the aggregate wraps it.

Let me revert my NotSupportedError and instead force the subquery path.
